historical_references.reference: Mangat Rai Chauhan was a Jat ruler of the Chauhan clan, who ruled the region of Sirsa in present-day Haryana, India during the late 12th and early 13th century.

Another Mangat, Mangat Rai, was a Rajput king of the Sisodia clan, who ruled the region of Mewar (present-day Rajasthan, India) during the late 15th century. He is known for his military victories against the Mughals and his role in preserving Rajput rule in the region.
